description: Sentus faction — portals and defensive power near BISMUTH.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Portals ◦ Sentus armies emerge from Portals instead of traditional factories.◦ Treat portals as forward bases: secure them early, then project power toward contested BISMUTH.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Defense near BISMUTH ◦ Sentus units gain bonus defense while fighting near friendly BISMUTH.◦ Anchor your line on income nodes — enemies pay full price to uproot you.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Summary Sentus excel at entrenched play: Portals for production and stubborn defenders bolstered by proximity to BISMUTH.
